description: This file defines the CustomerGroup class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It contains methods to add, edit, and delete customer groups, primarily by adding tasks to a task management system. The class extends a base Controller class and interacts with a task model to enqueue operations related to customer groups.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class handling customer group events such as add, edit, and delete, by scheduling related tasks.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update customer group list and info after a customer group is added.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update customer group list and info after a customer group is edited.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update customer group list and delete a specific customer group.
